observations.workflow_semantics: continue-on-error causes step conclusion surfaces to appear successful while steps.<id>.outcome remains failure; Enforce build gate checks outcomes and correctly fails closed

gap.missing_field: first textual Gradle failure cause shared by auth/unit/lint/assemble
gap.blocking_dependency: raw Actions log/diagnostic artifact payload not exposed by current connector surface
gap.evidence_needed: raw log or diagnostics artifact showing first non-wrapper failure
gap.falsifier: provider log shows distinct independent causes or a later eligible baseline run passes without code change
gap.next_probe: retrieve diagnostics/log artifact through a file-aware provider surface; otherwise compare exact Gradle environment/config against a passing historical run
gap.closure_gate: first cause identified and reproduced or terminally classified with provider evidence
